title: Open Agent Studio
description: An open-source visual AI agent builder for designing, testing, configuring, and deploying AI agents.
longDescription: Open Agent Studio is a full-stack AI agent platform created by Ali Rashid for building and managing AI agents through a visual node-based workflow builder. It supports configurable AI models, real-time streaming execution, MCP tools, encrypted provider credentials, API key management, Redis-backed rate limiting, and secure agent deployment APIs.

title: CityVerse — AI-Powered 3D Smart City Digital Twin
description: An interactive 3D smart city digital twin for visualizing, simulating, and managing urban infrastructure, traffic, energy, weather, and emergency scenarios.
longDescription: CityVerse is an AI-powered 3D Smart City Digital Twin created by Ali Rashid for exploring and simulating a procedurally generated smart city in real time. It features eight interactive districts including Downtown, Residential, Commercial, Industrial, University, Airport, Hospital, and Shopping. The platform includes animated traffic, dynamic time-of-day lighting, realistic weather modes, energy-flow visualization, building energy states, simulation controls, construction and road-closure tools, and emergency simulations. Built with Three.js and WebGL, CityVerse transforms complex urban data into an immersive, interactive digital environment for smart-city visualization and decision-making.

title: HomeVista 3D
description: AI-powered 3D real estate platform with an interactive master plan and immersive property visualization.
longDescription: HomeVista 3D is an AI-powered 3D real estate platform developed by Ali Rashid. It features an interactive master plan, immersive property visualization, intelligent plot recommendations, real-time home customization, investment estimation, and Google Gemini AI integration.

title: Earth Explorer
description: An immersive interactive 3D Earth experience built with Next.js, TypeScript, Three.js, and Tailwind CSS.
longDescription: Earth Explorer is an interactive 3D Earth experience that allows users to explore a realistic digital globe, rotate and zoom the planet, switch between day and night modes, explore countries and continents, search for locations, discover random destinations with Surprise Me, and enter fullscreen planetarium mode. The project also includes SEO-friendly country and continent pages, dynamic sitemap generation, robots.txt, structured metadata, and a responsive experience across desktop and mobile.

title: FoodVerse 3D
description: A luxury digital culinary gallery combining cinematic food photography, interactive 3D visualization, and futuristic web design.
longDescription: FoodVerse 3D is an immersive digital culinary gallery featuring 16 curated food experiences, cinematic animations, interactive 3D visualization architecture, high-quality food photography, multiple lighting environments, responsive layouts, dynamic food categories, and individual food detail pages. The platform uses a photography-first approach while supporting genuine GLB models through an automatic asset detection system.

title: NutriAI Pakistan
description: AI-powered nutrition and health management platform built around local Pakistani cuisine.
longDescription: NutriAI Pakistan is an AI-powered nutrition and health management platform designed around Pakistani cuisine. The project includes personalized meal planning, BMI and calorie calculations, nutrition analytics, grocery management, healthy recipes, AI nutrition assistance, and an integrated administration dashboard.

title: ReelFlow
description: A modern short-video social media platform with a mobile-first experience.
longDescription: ReelFlow is a modern short-video social media platform featuring video sharing, authentication, user profiles, and a mobile-first user experience. The project demonstrates full-stack web development and modern application design.

title: Finova AI
description: AI-powered personal finance and wealth management platform.
longDescription: Finova AI is an AI-powered personal finance and wealth management platform designed to help users track expenses, manage budgets, monitor savings goals, and gain intelligent financial insights through a modern responsive dashboard.

title: Aura Atelier
description: AI-powered 3D virtual fitting room and haute couture styling platform.
longDescription: Aura Atelier is an AI-powered 3D virtual fitting room and haute couture styling platform developed as part of Ali Rashid's exploration of AI, 3D web technologies, and interactive digital experiences. It features a Three.js fitting studio, AI fashion recommendations, digital wardrobe management, Google Drive cloud integration, and immersive styling experiences.

title: InterviewAI
description: An AI-powered career readiness and interview coaching platform.
longDescription: InterviewAI is an AI-powered career readiness and interview coaching platform developed to help students and professionals prepare for technical and behavioral interviews. It includes intelligent mock interviews, resume optimization, personalized feedback, and performance analytics.

title: FitNova AI
description: AI-powered fitness and wellness platform with an intelligent coach and health analytics.
longDescription: FitNova AI is an AI-powered fitness and wellness platform featuring an intelligent fitness coach, workout tracking, habit management, health analytics, and interactive dashboards. The project demonstrates Ali Rashid's interest in building AI-assisted applications and modern user experiences.

title: StudyFlow AI
description: AI-powered study companion with note summarization, tutoring, and quiz generation.
longDescription: StudyFlow AI is an AI-powered study companion designed for students. It provides smart note summarization, AI tutoring, quiz generation, and productivity features to support learning and study organization.

title: Chrono VeloSec Utility Suite
description: A C++ productivity toolkit demonstrating modern C++ programming concepts.
longDescription: Chrono VeloSec Utility Suite is a C++ productivity toolkit created to demonstrate modern C++ programming concepts, software design, problem solving, and practical utility development.

title: Arcana Console Game Suite
description: A collection of console-based games built in C++ showcasing OOP and game logic.
longDescription: Arcana Console Game Suite is a collection of console-based games developed in C++, showcasing object-oriented programming, game logic, algorithms, and problem-solving skills.
